summary: Implementation plan for upgrading UnlimCloud into a white-label public cloud storage platform with Firebase Google Sign-In, strict per-user data security, real-time upload progress bars, a Token & Storage Pricing system (25GB Free, 50GB for 500 tokens/mo, 1TB for 1024 tokens/mo, promo code '1tBfri26' for 9999 tokens, BDT/USD checkout, and 3-month grace period locking for >25GB excess data), rich file previews, and delete confirmation modals.
